cards.text: God has kept His promise: Sarah has given her husband Abraham a son, Isaac, in his old age (Genesis 21:1-3). At that time, Abimelech, king of Gerar (Genesis 20:2), comes to Abraham with Phicol, the commander of his army. Friend, when two bosses walk up to your desk together, you check your pulse.

cards.question: Abimelech opens with something he's noticed about Abraham. What does he say?

answers.text: God is with him in all he does
His flocks grow bigger every year

cards.text: Then Abimelech gets to the point: he wants Abraham to swear an oath, right there before God. Before GOD, friend, which is a whole lot bigger than "pinky promise, no take-backs."

cards.question: Abimelech wants Abraham to swear before God that he won't deal ___ with him or his children or descendants.

cards.text: He also asks Abraham to show him, and the country Abraham lives in, the same kindness he's shown Abraham. Kindness for kindness.

cards.question: Abraham agrees to swear the oath Abimelech asks for.

cards.text: Abraham answers: “I swear it.” Friend, that's faster than I say yes to a second cookie, and I say yes to a second cookie FAST.
Oath sworn. Then Abraham brings a complaint of his own to the king.

cards.question: What is Abraham's complaint to Abimelech about?

answers.text: A well the king's servants seized
Sheep stolen out of his flock
A field the king's army burned

cards.question: Abimelech tells Abraham he hadn't heard about the seized well until today.

cards.text: Abimelech says he doesn't know who did it, and he points out that Abraham never told him. Friend, that's every group chat: somebody finds out three days late and goes, "Wait. WHEN did this happen?"

cards.question: So Abraham gives Abimelech sheep and cattle, and the two men make a ___.

cards.text: Covenant made. Then Abraham separates seven ewe lambs from the flock, and I bet Abimelech's standing there like, "Uh. What are THOSE for?"

cards.question: Abimelech asks Abraham why he set apart the seven ewe lambs. What does Abraham say they are?

answers.text: His witness that he dug the well
A gift for the king's children
An offering for a safe journey

cards.question: The place where Abraham and Abimelech swore their oath gets a name. What is that place called?
After the covenant, Abimelech and Phicol return to the land of the Philistines.

cards.text: Abraham plants a tamarisk tree in Beersheba. Most people walk out of a big meeting and grab their phones, but Abraham grabs a SHOVEL.

cards.question: Abraham plants a tamarisk tree in Beersheba. What else does he do there?

answers.text: He calls on the name of the LORD
He builds a house for Sarah
He digs a second well nearby

cards.question: Abraham soon moves on from the land of the Philistines.

cards.text: Don't take your apron off yet, friend. Abraham's story still has a few batches in it.
